items.quote: Ryan and his crew came through for us when we needed them most. We had several dead pine trees that needed to be removed. They showed up with some impressive equipment, craned the trees out, and had everything piled up in no time. Fantastic pricing, top-notch equipment, and an even better crew!

The Canopy crew went well above and beyond when we had them come out to remove a 90 foot pine tree from our back yard. They rolled up with a crew of 10 and knocked it out quickly. Aside from their incredible professionalism and knowledge, you could hardly tell anything had happened in our yard.

Ryan and his team did a fantastic job. They worked effectively and did an amazing job. I was very impressed with the clean up also, they took great care putting my yard better than it was before they started.
